stereotypeDefinition.comment: Rate limits this gateway route with the gateway's shared rate limit rule. The rule's numbers live in ocelot.json, under GlobalConfiguration.RateLimitOptions (Limit, Period, Wait, ClientIdHeader, ClientWhitelist), and are yours to edit; the Software Factory only keeps its RouteKeys in step with the routes that have this stereotype. Ocelot identifies the client by the ClientIdHeader request header (Oc-Client by default); a request without it is answered with 503. Routes without this stereotype are not rate limited.
stereotypeDefinition.hint: Rate limit this route with the gateway's shared rule in ocelot.json
